dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So this is the neighborhood where you grew up!
dialogue.reading: soʊ ðɪs ɪz ðə ˈneɪbərhʊd wɛr juː ˈɡruː ˈʌp!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! And that's the house where my parents live.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ənd ðæts ðə ˈhaʊs wɛr maɪ ˈpɛrənts ˈlɪv.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's so quiet here. There are no skyscrapers!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈsoʊ ˈkwaɪət ˈhɪr. ðɛr ər ˈnoʊ ˈskaɪskreɪpərz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's right. Look, this is the canal where I used to feed the fish.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ˈlʊk, ðɪs ɪz ðə kəˈnæl wɛr aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈfiːd ðə ˈfɪʃ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And what's that square over there?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌts ðæt ˈskwɛr ˈoʊvər ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's the square where the night market is. It opens every Friday.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ðə ˈskwɛr wɛr ðə ˈnaɪt ˌmɑːrkɪt ˈɪz. ɪt ˈoʊpənz ˈɛvri ˈfraɪdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is the night market a tourist attraction?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðə ˈnaɪt ˌmɑːrkɪt ə ˈtʊrɪst əˌtrækʃən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not really. It's a place where local people meet and eat.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. ɪts ə ˈpleɪs wɛr ˈloʊkəl ˈpiːpəl ˈmiːt ənd ˈiːt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'd like to try the food there.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈtraɪ ðə ˈfuːd ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then let's come on Friday! I know a shop where the noodles are amazing.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈlɛts ˈkʌm ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ! aɪ ˈnoʊ ə ˈʃɑːp wɛr ðə ˈnuːdəlz ər əˈmeɪzɪŋ.
